title: 770. Basic Calculator IV

examples.explanation: Known vars collapse to the constant 5.

hints: Represent a polynomial as a map from sorted variable list to coefficient; addition merges maps and multiplication takes pairwise products with merged sorted keys.
Parse with standard precedence (parentheses, then *, then +-) and replace any variable found in the eval map by its constant.
Portable note: the expression is a plain string and the answer is a string list ordered by degree descending then variable part ascending.
